subject.title: fix(browser): snapshots fail when managed proxy is enabled

question: Does the browser/network owner approve resolving CDP HTTP discovery inside OpenClaw and granting managed-proxy bypasses only to the validated discovery routes and resulting WebSocket endpoint?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and improves policy control, but it changes which exact browser-control URLs may bypass the managed proxy, so final acceptance of that trust boundary belongs to the relevant owner.

options.title: Approve exact scoped bypass
options.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the proxy-policy and required checks, and merge if the exact HTTP-route and WebSocket lease tests remain green.

options.title: Pause for boundary redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open and narrow or redesign the bypass contract if browser control must not receive direct exact-URL leases under the current proxy model.

recommendation.title: Approve exact scoped bypass
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, rerun the proxy-policy and required checks, and merge if the exact HTTP-route and WebSocket lease tests remain green.
